title: moderation.screen_draft
description: Screen an UNPUBLISHED draft synchronously and answer whether it may be published. The payload carries the content itself — title, text, language, photos, author — because a draft has no stored target to read it from. Photos come by either of two doors: "media" (CDN refs, resolved through cdn.describe) for content that has already been uploaded, and "images" ({data_b64, mime} entries handed straight to the model) for a draft whose bytes have not settled into a ref yet. Not approved: a Case of origin "draft" is persisted with its Verdict, resolved, and the refusal is appealable through the ordinary appeal flow; approved: nothing is persisted, so an approved draft never enters the human queue. A screener that could not answer honours ON_SCREENING_FAILURE / ON_SCREENING_UNAVAILABLE and never returns allowed=true on the strength of a failure. Response: {"allowed": boolean, "decision": string, "reason_code": string, "rationale": string, "confidence": number|null, "source": string, "case_id": string|null, "appeal_url": string}.

target_type.description: Registry key; an unregistered type raises. The policy decides the rules, the reason vocabulary and whether media is screened.

title.description: The draft's title, "" for a target family that has none.

language.description: BCP-47 tag of the draft, "" when the composer does not know.

media.description: CDN media refs ("<type>/<hash>"), resolved through cdn.describe and bounded by MAX_MEDIA_PER_CASE.

author_id.description: The draft's author. Also the default subject of the case a refusal persists.

subject_user_id.description: The person a refusal is about, when that is not the author_id. Defaults to author_id.

reports.description: Reason codes of existing complaints to give the screener as context. Ordinarily empty — a draft nobody has seen has no complaints.

mime.description: Must be image/*; anything else refuses the call.

images.description: Inline image bytes for a draft that has no CDN ref yet. Bounded by MAX_MEDIA_PER_CASE (count) and MAX_INLINE_IMAGE_BYTES (total decoded size); over either bound the call is REFUSED rather than trimmed, because a trimmed draft is a verdict about photos nobody looked at.
